name: Aurelio Larsdóttir-Hernández
role: Field trauma surgeon and combat support — combat medic
location: The Canopy — elevated walkway district above Geartown, near Clark and Belmont
description:
Aurelio Larsdóttir-Hernández is tall and loose-limbed, moving with the deliberate economy of someone who has trained every motion. At 42, his face carries the layered heritage of generations of diaspora mixing — features that resist easy categorization and reward attention. The chrome is visible — hydraulic joints in knees and elbows — absorbs falls, amplifies strikes — and he makes no effort to hide it.

He arrived in GLMZ six years ago with nothing but chrome and debts, and has been working off both ever since. He works as a combat medic out of The Canopy, taking contracts that match his skills and his risk tolerance, which is higher than most people consider healthy.

Aurelio Larsdóttir-Hernández operates in a narrow band between competence and recklessness that makes fixers nervous and clients satisfied.

core_fears: Becoming obsolete as augmentation technology outpaces their chrome
Their past catching up — debts, enemies, broken promises
Dying alone in some alley and nobody noticing for weeks
core_desires: A crew worth trusting — people who stay when the shooting starts
Reputation — to be the name fixers whisper when the job absolutely cannot fail
Control — over their body, their schedule, their future
coping_mechanisms: Compartmentalization — work feelings and personal feelings exist in separate boxes
Maintains weapons obsessively — cleaning guns is meditation
Planning — responds to chaos by making detailed contingency plans for everything
blind_spots: Cannot see that their independence is actually isolation wearing a better outfit
Trusts technology more than people — machines don't betray
Assumes their skill set is more transferable than it actually is
psychology.secret: Nurlan Holm-Danquah sends anonymous tips to GLMZ law enforcement about competitors. It's not principle — it's market manipulation.

speech_patterns.vocabulary: Flat affect, monotone delivery. The content is terrifying but the voice never rises.
speech_patterns.cadence: Rhythmic, almost musical — the sentence structure has a pattern even when the words are brutal.
verbal_tics: Repeats the last thing someone said back to them before responding — processing or intimidation
Whispers when angry — the quieter the voice, the worse the situation
example_lines: "Hold still. This is going to hurt and I don't care."
"I can keep you alive through almost anything. What I can't do is make you grateful."
"Blood type? No, I don't need your blood type. I need you to stop moving."

story_hooks: A former associate resurfaces with evidence that could destroy Nurlan Holm-Danquah's reputation — and a price for silence
A crew member from Nurlan Holm-Danquah's past shows up in GLMZ, carrying old grievances and new chrome
Nurlan Holm-Danquah is offered a contract that would clear all their debts — the target is someone they respect
narrative_function: Nurlan Holm-Danquah represents the working professional of the runner world — competent, reliable, and slowly being consumed by a lifestyle that doesn't accommodate aging or doubt. His stories explore what happens when skill meets systemic injustice.
augmentations: Hydraulic joints in knees and elbows — absorbs falls, amplifies strikes. Eye replacement — one organic, one cybernetic with recording capability and zoom
daily_life: Lives nocturnally. The work happens at night, so the body follows. Days are for sleeping, equipment maintenance, and the occasional meeting with fixers who keep normal hours. The circadian disruption is permanent and accepted.
affiliation: Independent — known in Old Harbor circles

strengths: social chameleon — adapts to any environment
weaknesses: poor impulse control in specific triggers
risk-averse to the point of missed opportunities

decision_rules: Always demands half payment upfront — trust is a luxury, Quanta is concrete
Will abandon a job if the intel was deliberately falsified — being set up violates the contract
Never discusses active contracts with anyone not directly involved
Maintains a personal blacklist of clients who've burned runners — checks it religiously
escalation_ladder: 2. Evade — avoid the problem entirely if possible
3. Misdirect — create a distraction, redirect attention
4. Disable — targeted takedowns, quiet and efficient
5. Eliminate — when silence is no longer an option
6. Vanish — disappear completely, burn identity if necessary

interpersonal_modes.employers: Guarded respect. They pay, the job gets done. Anything beyond that is liability.
interpersonal_modes.crew: Loyal but reserved. Trusts their competence, withholds personal information by reflex.
interpersonal_modes.strangers: Dismissive unless they demonstrate usefulness or threat potential. Time is a resource.
interpersonal_modes.threats: Calm escalation. Each response is proportional until it isn't, and the transition is seamless.

stress_responses.low: Channels it into preparation — checks gear, reviews plans, contacts sources.
stress_responses.medium: Withdrawal. Conversations become monosyllabic. Focus narrows to the immediate problem.
stress_responses.high: Controlled aggression. The training takes over. Emotions are packed into a box for later.
stress_responses.critical: Disassociation. The body operates on training while the mind retreats to somewhere safe. Comes back disoriented.

contradictions: Claims not to care about reputation but monitors what people say about them obsessively
Preaches independence but is desperate for approval from people they respect
habits: Maintains a dead drop with emergency supplies in three separate districts
Sleeps with one hand on a weapon — has done this for so long it's not deliberate anymore
Never drinks anything they didn't see poured or open themselves
Counts ammunition obsessively — knows the exact round count at all times
breaking_points: Complete isolation — cut off from network, contacts, and purpose simultaneously
Betrayal by the one person they actually trust — the single point of failure in their emotional architecture
Losing their primary augmentation — the one that defines their professional identity

physical_description.heritage: Quintessential Ubiquitous Diaspora lineage: Southeast Asian plurality (33.6%) forms the structural foundation, complemented by substantial Sub-Saharan African (21.1%) and Hispanic/Latin American (22.8%) ancestry, with Eastern European (17.7%) and East Asian (4.8%) contributing undertones. The genetic combination produces a phenotype that transcends traditional categorical boundaries — a living archive of global migration patterns across multiple generations and continents.
physical_description.build: Lean and angular, muscle distributed for endurance rather than bulk. Long-limbed with visible definition in shoulders and forearms. The hydraulic augmentations in knees and elbows add subtle mechanical mass without disrupting his overall wiry efficiency.
physical_description.hair_color: Dark brown with premature silver threading through the sides
physical_description.hair_style: Kept short and practical, swept back from the forehead. No vanity in the cut — purely functional.
physical_description.eye_color: Left eye: warm brown, organic. Right eye: luminous cyan with visible chrome iris housing and faint grid pattern overlay when zoomed.
physical_description.skin_tone: Deep warm bronze with golden-amber undertones — a seamless blend of Southeast Asian warmth, Sub-Saharan depth, Hispanic radiance, and Eastern European olive undertones. Weathered and sun-exposed despite nocturnal work schedule, creating a lived-in patina.
physical_description.complexion: Angular face with high, prominent cheekbones and defined jaw reflecting the Southeast Asian and Sub-Saharan structural ancestry, warmed by Hispanic and Eastern European undertones creating a multi-continental aesthetic that resists simple categorization. Permanent exhaustion lines around the eyes. Small surgical scar below the left temple (artifact of the eye replacement). Minimal facial hair — kept clean-shaved or at a three-day shadow. Skin shows the wear of someone who doesn't prioritize sleep quality, despite sleeping long hours.
distinguishing_marks: Pale surgical scar running 3cm below the left temple, where the cybernetic eye was integrated.
Thin white scar across the dorsal surface of the right hand — old blade wound, pre-augmentation.
Faint burn marks on the inside of both wrists — subcutaneous neural interface insertion sites, deliberately left visible as a credential.
physical_description.visible_augmentations: Chrome hydraulic joints dominate both knees and elbows — polished steel with visible pressure seals and micro-articulation housings. The right eye is unmistakably artificial: a luminous cyan iris with a visible chrome housing ring. No effort to hide any of it; the augmentations are worn as proof of competence and hard-won survival.
physical_description.posture_movement: Moves with deliberate economy — every motion calculated and efficient. No wasted gesture. When standing still, he's coiled rather than relaxed, weight balanced on the balls of his feet as though ready to move or absorb impact. His gait is smooth despite the augmented joints, suggesting years of recalibration and training. In conversation, minimal facial expression; information is gathered more than given.
physical_description.clothing_style: Tier 3-4 practicality. Tends toward dark, non-reflective fabrics — black or charcoal synthetic blend cargo pants with reinforced seams and deep pockets. Fitted tactical shirts (usually unmarked, sometimes with internal vest anchors visible at the shoulders). Worn leather jacket, vintage pre-2180s, patched at the elbows with modern synthetic mesh. Practical boots with grip soles. No logos, no corpo affiliation markers. Everything is functional; nothing is aspirational.
